summaries.Good news: Today's stories showcase nature rebounding when given the chance—from Indonesian rainforests saved by early rice self-sufficiency to a Samoan island's wildlife explosion after invasive species removal. Real progress is happening in climate solutions too, with sustainable jet fuel from coconut oil and battery-like carbon capture technology offering genuine pathways forward.
summaries.Ideas: AI is reshaping enterprise operations with context-aware systems and scalable foundations, while simultaneously raising hard questions about job displacement, data storage costs, and the human skills that remain irreplaceable. The week's earnings reports reveal a tech sector wrestling with AI's real costs versus its promised returns.
summaries.Technology: Breakthrough science is moving fast—from high-temperature superconductors closing the gap on ambient conditions to AI-designed enzymes achieving atomic precision, while practical innovations tackle everyday problems like motorcycle safety and space debris. A functional cure for hepatitis B marks a major medical milestone.
summaries.Design: Design thinking is deepening beyond aesthetics into systems and ritual: from acoustic spaces that prioritize listening experience to buildings that respect existing ecosystems, to centuries-old cooking traditions meeting contemporary design challenges. This year's design awards emphasize projects that 'hold up beyond aesthetics'—substance over style.

items.title: Breakthrough hepatitis B drug offers 'functional cure' for first time
items.snippet: For the first time, many people living with chronic hepatitis B may have a functional cure at hand. items.line: The FDA's approval of Hibsago offers the first functional cure for chronic hepatitis B without requiring endless antiviral drugs, representing a genuine breakthrough for millions living with the disease.
